dedupe_keys.name: buenos aires housing complexes and cooperatives of the city housing institute ivc

description: Instituto de Vivienda de la Ciudad (IVC), Buenos Aires publishes two layers of housing sites in which the Instituto de Vivienda de la Ciudad works: housing complexes (conjuntos urbanos) and cooperatives, meaning dwellings, buildings and building complexes it creates, maintains, titles or allocates credit for, and the cooperatives that act as intermediaries at some sites. Coverage: the City of Buenos Aires, Argentina; marked as a historical dataset and last modified on 2026-06-30. Format and access: CSV, XLSX, ZIP, GEOJSON, downloadable without registration from the Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-2.5-AR; cost: free. Caveats: the portal marks it as historical, so new sites may be missing; unit counts and attributes were not read. Simulation uses: social-housing stock and exposure layers for equity-aware resilience and relocation scenarios. Related catalogue records: other layers and datasets of the same portal in this catalogue are contextual companions.
